exposure: Mode of delivery in the first preterm delivery
Mode of preterm delivery (cesarean delivery vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Rate of recurrent preterm delivery < 37 weeks
Rate of recurrent preterm delivery < 34 weeks
cohort: 1019 women with spontaneous preterm first delivery
finding: Mode of delivery in the first preterm delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery) was not associated with recurrent preterm delivery in a subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in the first preterm delivery was not associated with recurrent preterm delivery.
